# Independent ORIGINAL scope and noncircularity analysis

Verdict: PASS for the unchanged candidate in the original defined finite globally embedded BMPS category and the stipulated coefficient/positive-real weight extensions. The proof is an infinite structural certificate classification. It supplies no finite taxonomy, computable real-coefficient oracle, bounded tree depth, finite carrier list, universal real orthogonality or countable replacement of the stated quantifiers. These omissions do not omit instances of the actual target.

## What the original target requires

The atomic target and completion criteria ask for necessary and sufficient structural/geometric conditions on the actual balanced pair/reference for simultaneous genuine endpoint regularization and exact raw contact for ALL admissible obstacles. Both literal integral-slope/rational-constant and genuine finite real-scalar PA conventions matter. The entire family dossier, not only the atomic line, was read. It includes nonseparable obstacles and higher-dimensional real cases; it does not require a terminating algorithm or a finite combinatorial list. A condition that simply calls the unknown envelope/measure and asserts their orthogonality would fail. A narrower fan/product/arrangement theorem, mass test, or added unexplained regularity premise would also fail.

Here the real success predicate T quantifies bounded genuine finite PA obstacle tuples u, their rational carrier geometry and actual coefficients, and epsilon>0. It asks for a finite common carrier, genuine matching coefficients p, explicit finite common-support rows on ENTIRE original incident cells, exact recession, p<=gamma+u, a fixed relative bound, legal finite printed trees with small cost at every real root, and the finite gap polynomial. A particular carrier's matching/PC/recession/order/norm/gap components are explicit finite algebra. Each root's tree has finite actual node incidence, rational endpoint lists and real barycentric data. Neither the predicate nor its verifiable witness syntax calls an unknown endpoint or completed operator.

## Why the eliminations have structural content

The first elimination is not merely writing “p is PC.” One ambient covector for each original tau/carrier rho must agree on rho and support every part of every original incident top cell. Its finite rows retain rational matching, constants, actual gamma right sides, all saturated intrinsic directions, dependencies and overlaps. Exact finite projection removes support variables if desired. Whole-cell support is stronger than a merely local guessed support; its necessity is justified by qualified O323 and coarse-cell propagation, and its sufficiency independently forces all printed PCCs, including ones on different structures. Thus the condition supplies actual incident geometry constraints rather than assuming feasibility of the unknown continuous endpoint.

The second elimination is not “choose p close to the envelope.” It gives a specified class of finite geometric witnesses whose costs involve only the obstacle. The raw identity is proved independently by finite grafting for all finite-valued printed competitors, before completing them or measuring anything. It includes irrational downward spikes and upper-only growth, unsplit real roots, real weights, repeated nodes and each internal node's own rational structure. Telescoping retains the exact actual reference costs. The proof establishes what the input-only tree clause means; an infimum in the PROOF is not an oracle in the PREDICATE. A bare terminal barycenter would be a materially different and generally illegal certificate.

The third elimination is not “the MA gap is small.” Each proposed finite p has a prescribed saturated inward primitive recursion through every dimension, retaining signed and zero stages. Its vertex weights are explicit slope polynomials with actual REAL cycle weights, not an unmentioned completed measure or Alexandrov volume. The weighted finite slack sum is consequently specified algebra on the input tuple. Positivity and normalization follow from the checked real product/support conversion, not from clipping or a factorial adjustment.

There is also a substantive sufficiency step beyond those translations: selecting T witnesses at epsilon_n=2^-n gives e-p_n in[0,epsilon_n], then g_n=p_n+4epsilon_n has strict drop>=epsilon_n and global uniform error tending to zero. This produces the exact actual-reference domain BEFORE the raw completed measure. The finite gap bound then converges to exact contact. The all-continuous domain bridge is independently established before the local contact passage. Hence T is not an unexplained conditional premise simply identifying a property with itself; it is a complete characterization by concrete support, incidence, cost and primitive-polynomial certificates, with both directions proved.

The tree clause deliberately recovers envelope comparison, and the polynomial clause deliberately recovers contact. Hiding such quantities behind renamed symbols without explicit constructions or proofs would not suffice. Here they have actually been eliminated into the stated geometry/coefficients. An exact necessary-and-sufficient criterion inevitably retains equivalent information about its target; that alone is not circularity. The original permits infinite structural conditions. This is the decisive reason for PASS, rather than the absence of forbidden words or the favorable O323 scope label.

This criterion gives less geometric compression than the S262 graph weight-ray theorem or S282 disjoint-plane theorem. It has no finite local obstruction list and no search stopping rule. Failure of one carrier, root search or bounded-depth computation is not failure of T. Those are meaningful limitations of the characterization, but the original does not demand that additional compression. The arbitrary obstacles, carriers, actual coefficients, incidences and weights have not been narrowed to obtain the equivalence.

## Independent category decision

The fixed BMPSv1 Definitions2.2/2.4/2.27 define finite closed-face rational complexes in ONE N_R, with a strictly positive pure balanced top cycle. The formal source weights are rational; the task separately stipulates actual positive-real balance. The proofs cover that extension through the checked real raw recursion and S272 completion. An atlas, transition maps, line-bundle-valued reference, compactification boundary cycle or new global PCC convention is not supplied by the original dossier.

I did not infer P05.2's category solely from O323's accepted P05.1 decision. The original whole dossier's named compact higher-dimensional literal residual, compact graph hypotheticals and analytic skeleton comparison were compared with the actual source definitions. They supply no alternative object definition. For a globally embedded finite positive cycle, the compact contradiction is direct. Let a_sigma be the saturated lattice covolume. A facet basis plus primitive inward lift gives height a_sigma/a_tau; primitive balancing becomes sum w_sigma a_sigma nu_sigma/tau=0. Ordinary divergence summed over cells cancels ALL facets. If X were compact and d>0, a compactly supported Y equal to x near X would give

0=d sum_sigma w_sigma a_sigma vol_d(sigma)>0.

Thus this defined category has no nonempty compact positive-dimensional pair. The compact branch is resolved as empty, not removed by imposing noncompactness. A finite bounded skeleton may fail balancing at its boundary. An abstract compact graph can have local balanced charts but is not a finite global positive cycle of the source definition. P05.5's analytic/boundary comparisons describe separate objects. Inventing atlas transitions to make the compact prose nonvacuous would change the task rather than complete its defined branch. No theorem for that invented category is accepted.

Noncompact embedded supports may still have incidence loops, nonfree attachments, dependent spans, arbitrary proper support cells and multiple overlaps; the criterion retains all of them. A gamma-affine refined cell is pointed because its actual affine slope is positive on every nonzero recession direction, but the original coarse support need not itself be a single pointed cell or a complete plane. This is a consequence of the admitted reference, not an additional restriction on the pair class.

Dimension zero: finite rational points, singleton PCCs, e=gamma+u. Arbitrary real values on this finite set have strict-decreasing rational PA value approximants in the literal branch as well as real ones. The actual zero-fold measure is the specified weighted point cycle; exact contact is zero.

This is a domain failure, not an integral of an undefined measure.

Every nonempty positive-dimensional admitted real pair has simultaneous genuine domain and exact contact for every bounded finite genuine PA obstacle, equivalently every C_b obstacle, iff T holds. The actual reference coefficients and exact recession, actual positive REAL weights and all original/refined faces remain in that equivalence. Complete affine spaces/arrangements and flat-atom bad jets are only consistency sectors of this general condition. No universal real satisfaction of T is claimed.
